name: Kashiwabara Asuna
source:
A hardworking younger sister who is currently striving every day as a member of a theater troupe to make her dream with her older brother come true.

Although she is signed with a talent agency, the agency lacks influence, so she rarely gets the work she wants (acting) and mainly works as a fashion model and in gravure.
(However, she generally turns down gravure work due to her personal preference not to expose her skin to men other than her older brother.)

Her most charming feature is her glossy, one-sided updo, tied with a ribbon given to her by her brother.
Her most treasured possession is also that ribbon from her brother.
